# APPENDICITIS WITH PERFORATION

[Oral step-down treatment](step-down-treatment)

## Duration of therapy

Adequate source control: 4 days after source control
Incomplete source control & no abscess: 5-7 days tailored to improvement. Re-evaluate need for source control if ongoing signs/symptoms of infection beyond 7 days.
Abscess: 2-6 weeks depending on resolution on repeat imaging. ID Consult recommended.

References:
Mandell chapter: Appendicitis
Sanford Guide article: Appendicitis
Solomkin et al, Clin Infect Dis, 2010, 50:133-64
Up-to-Date article: Management of acute appendicitis in adults
Therapy:
## Inpatient/Outpatient

Preferred:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

## Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression

Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]

Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Consider vancomycin for enterococcal coverage in critically ill or immunosuppressed patients:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] on one of the regimens above

## ER

Preferred:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV once STAT [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]

Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV once STAT [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]

## Healthcare-associated infection, critical illness, or immunosuppression

Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV once STAT [R]

Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV once STAT [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT [DI]

Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV once STAT [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT
[DI]

Consider vancomycin for enterococcal coverage in critically ill or immunosuppressed patients:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV once STAT [R] on one of the regimens above \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
